description:
Upstream configuration defining backend service nodes and load balancing behavior.

An upstream must specify either `nodes` (static list) or `service_name` + `discovery_type` (service discovery).

Declarative upstream configuration. The optional `modifiedIndex` controls resource-level change detection with the YAML configuration provider.

create_time.description: Unix timestamp when the upstream was created. Read-only, set automatically.

update_time.description: Unix timestamp when the upstream was last updated. Read-only, set automatically.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts when a request to the upstream fails.

retry_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for retry attempts. `0` disables the retry timeout.

x-enumDescriptions.ewma: Latency-based load balancing using an exponentially weighted moving average.

hash_on.description: What to hash on when `type` is `chash`.

x-enumDescriptions.vars: Hash on an NGINX variable specified by `key`.
x-enumDescriptions.header: Hash on a request header specified by `key`.
x-enumDescriptions.cookie: Hash on a cookie value specified by `key`.
x-enumDescriptions.consumer: Hash on the authenticated consumer name.
x-enumDescriptions.vars_combinations: Hash on a combination of variables.

key.description: The hash key used when `type` is `chash`. Required when `hash_on` is `header`, `cookie`, `vars`, or `vars_combinations`. Not needed when `hash_on` is `consumer`.

scheme.description: Protocol for communicating with upstream nodes.

x-enumDescriptions.wss: Frame-aware WebSocket proxying over TLS; uses the shared CA trust store, not `tls.ca_certs`.

pass_host.description: How to set the `Host` header when proxying to the upstream.

upstream_host.description: Custom `Host` header value. Only effective when `pass_host` is `rewrite`.

discovery_type.description: Service discovery type (e.g., `dns`, `consul`, `nacos`, `eureka`). Required when using service discovery instead of static `nodes`.

namespace_id.description: Namespace ID for Nacos service discovery.

service_name.description: Service name for service discovery. Required when `discovery_type` is set.

modifiedIndex.description: Optional resource version used for change detection by the YAML configuration provider.
